Name: Türkiye Scholarships
Majors: Business & Economics, Health & Medicine, STEM, Arts & Humanities, Law, Education
Description: overview: Türkiye Scholarships is a highly competitive, government-funded program that provides international students with the opportunity to pursue undergraduate, master's, and PhD degrees at prestigious Turkish universities. It is renowned for being one of the most comprehensive scholarship programs globally. The scholarship covers tuition fees, accommodation, health insurance, a monthly stipend, and a one-year Turkish language course. It also guarantees university placement, distinguishing it from many other programs. Designed to foster global leaders, it supports students in a wide range of academic fields.

Name: Stipendium Hungaricum (Hungary)
Majors: STEM, Business & Economics, Arts & Humanities, Education
Description: overview: The Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship is a fully funded program offered by the Hungarian Government, designed to attract top international students from over 90 partner countries. It covers undergraduate, master's, and doctoral programs across various fields of study. The scholarship provides tuition-free education, a monthly living stipend, medical insurance, and a contribution towards accommodation costs. By studying in Hungary, scholars benefit from high-quality European education, cultural immersion, and an internationally recognized degree, fostering international academic cooperation and cultural exchange.

Name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship (France)
Description: overview: The France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship Program, established by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs, aims to attract top international students for Master's and PhD programs in France. It focuses on priority fields such as science, engineering, humanities, and social sciences to train future foreign decision-makers. The scholarship provides a generous monthly allowance, international return travel, health insurance, and cultural activities. While it does not cover tuition fees, it offers significant financial support and prestige for students studying at leading French institutions.

Name: Rhodes Scholarship (Oxford)
Majors: Other, STEM, Business & Economics, Arts & Humanities, Health & Medicine
Description: overview: Established in 1902, the Rhodes Scholarship is the world's oldest and most prestigious international scholarship program. It enables exceptional young leaders from around the globe to pursue fully-funded postgraduate studies at the University of Oxford. The scholarship covers all university and college fees, a monthly living stipend, and travel expenses. Selection is highly competitive, based on outstanding academic achievement, character, leadership potential, and a commitment to service. Scholars join a lifelong global community dedicated to making a positive impact on the world.

Name: Peking University CSC Scholarship (China)
Majors: Other, Business & Economics, Health & Medicine, Law, STEM
Description: overview: The Peking University Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) is a fully-funded program that allows international students to pursue graduate and doctoral degrees at one of China's top universities. Administered by the China Scholarship Council, it covers tuition fees, on-campus accommodation, comprehensive medical insurance, and a monthly living allowance. The program aims to foster international exchange and academic excellence. It supports a wide range of disciplines, offering students the opportunity to study in English or Chinese while experiencing China's rich culture and academic environment.
